items.problem: `spec`: the behavior that `save_withdrawn_response` does not save a response whose `ResponseEnvelope` has `error` (`### request ID` of the idempotency spec) has no test. In `server/core/idempotency/tests/` the only error-response test (`request-id.test.ts` "does not store an error response") sends with handler `failing`, which does not delete the user, so `save_withdrawn_response` returns early on `user_deleted` `false`, never on `!is_success(response)`. No other test file calls `save_withdrawn_response`. The only tests that reach `save_withdrawn_response` with `user_deleted` `true` use handler `withdraw`, which always returns a success body. So no test fails when `\|\| !is_success(response)` is removed from line 204 (found by reading the tests, not by a run). This existed before the commit range and is unrelated to its changes
